description: Provisioned AppX packages removed from the offline image. pfn: the package family name, so an app the source image does not carry is marked deprovisioned too (only names read from a real package). Names are matched exactly (no wildcards). A package that is not present in the image is skipped and logged. The build aborts if any removal entry also matches a protected pattern.

notRemovedByDesign.label: Widgets (MicrosoftWindows.Client.WebExperience)

notRemovedByDesign.label: OneDrive
notRemovedByDesign.reason: OneDriveSetup.exe is a serviced OS file. Only the first-logon auto-setup Run entry is removed so updates never fail on a missing file. Install OneDrive later if wanted.

notRemovedByDesign.label: Get Help, Camera, Clock, Media Player, Sound Recorder, Phone Link
notRemovedByDesign.reason: Kept (a project decision): everyday tools that many people use.

notRemovedByDesign.label: Copilot (Microsoft.Copilot)
notRemovedByDesign.reason: Nothing to remove: the app is not in the 26H2 image this kit builds from (the build manifest's provisionedAfter list). If a later source ISO carries it, add it to remove.

notRemovedByDesign.label: Edge, WebView2, Store, Xbox/Gaming components, codecs, frameworks
notRemovedByDesign.reason: Required for the Store, games and their launchers, the NVIDIA App, and feature updates.

notRemovedByDesign.label: Microsoft 365 (Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub)
notRemovedByDesign.reason: Kept by default: many users rely on Microsoft 365. Earlier builds removed it, but the Store can install it again for a user anyway. To remove it, take it off the protect list and add it to remove.
